summary: Iteration 27 testing complete. Save List feature fully tested: All backend APIs working (create list, get user lists, delete list, CSV download, admin get all lists, admin analytics). Frontend Save List modal and My Lists panel working with proper UI elements. Admin User Lists tab showing analytics (total lists, saves, unique users, top strains, effects, category breakdown). Effects feature verified as working in grower submission form, admin add/edit strain forms, and catalog filter sidebar.
passed_tests: ✅ Backend: POST /api/user/lists creates saved list with strain IDs, strain names, and filter metadata
✅ Backend: GET /api/user/lists returns user's saved lists (sorted by date desc)
✅ Backend: DELETE /api/user/lists/{id} deletes list and returns 404 for invalid IDs
✅ Backend: GET /api/user/lists/{id}/csv returns CSV file with proper headers and strain data
✅ Backend: GET /api/admin/lists returns all user-saved lists (admin only)
✅ Backend: GET /api/admin/lists/analytics returns total_lists, total_saves, unique_users, top_strains, top_effects, category_breakdown
✅ Backend: All user list endpoints require authentication (401 for unauthenticated)
✅ Backend: Admin endpoints require admin token (401 for non-admin)
✅ Frontend: Catalog page shows 'Save List' and 'My Lists' buttons above strain grid
✅ Frontend: Save List modal shows filtered strain count (e.g., 'Save 32 Strains')
✅ Frontend: Save List modal has name input with placeholder 'e.g., March 2026 Sativa Picks'
✅ Frontend: Save List modal shows active filter tags (category, type, effects)
✅ Frontend: My Lists panel shows saved lists with name, strain count, date, strain name chips
✅ Frontend: My Lists panel has CSV download button and delete button per list
✅ Frontend: Admin User Lists tab is last tab in admin navigation
✅ Frontend: Admin User Lists shows analytics: Total Lists, Total Saves, Unique Users
✅ Frontend: Admin User Lists shows 'Most Saved Strains' with strain names and save counts
✅ Frontend: Admin User Lists shows 'Most Common Effects' with effect names and counts
✅ Frontend: Admin User Lists shows 'Category Breakdown' with category names and counts
✅ Frontend: Admin User Lists shows all lists with user_email, user_company, strain_count, strain_names
✅ Frontend: EffectsMultiSelect visible in grower submission form (data-testid='grower-effects-select')
✅ Frontend: EffectsMultiSelect shows categorized effects (MOOD & EMOTION, MENTAL & COGNITIVE, etc.)
✅ Frontend: EffectsMultiSelect in Admin Add Strain form (data-testid='add-strain-effects')
✅ Frontend: Effects filter in catalog sidebar allows filtering strains by effects

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All Save List and Effects feature UI components verified via Playwright)

seed_data_creation: Test list 'My Test List' with 2 strains (Jealousy, AIS) exists from prior testing. Created test user 'test_savelist@test.com' for API testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 27 verified Save List feature: 1) Backend endpoints at /api/user/lists (CRUD + CSV) and /api/admin/lists (all lists + analytics) working correctly with proper auth. 2) Frontend Save List button opens modal with strain count, name input, filter tags. 3) My Lists panel shows saved lists with CSV download and delete actions. 4) Admin User Lists tab shows comprehensive analytics: total lists/saves/users, top saved strains, most common effects, category breakdown. 5) Effects feature from iteration 26 also re-verified - EffectsMultiSelect working in grower form and admin add strain form. Key data-testids: save-list-btn, my-lists-btn, save-list-modal, save-list-name-input, save-list-confirm-btn, my-lists-panel, admin-tab-saved-lists, grower-effects-select, add-strain-effects, filter-effects.
